items.headline: Israel's Election Ends in Deadlock as Netanyahu's Bloc Falls Short of Majority
items.summary: Israel's Central Elections Committee finalized the national election results, showing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition won 53 seats and fell short of the 61 needed for a parliamentary majority. The outcome creates a political deadlock as opposing political parties begin complex negotiations to form the next government.

items.headline: Astronauts Complete Historic 100th U.S. Spacewalk to Upgrade Space Station Power
items.summary: Astronauts Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk completed a seven-hour spacewalk on October 29, 2026, to unroll a new 63-foot solar array on the International Space Station. The successful mission marked the 100th U.S. spacewalk conducted without a space shuttle docked and will help increase the station's overall electrical supply.

items.headline: Milwaukee Brewers Win First World Series Title in Franchise History
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to secure the first World Series championship in franchise history. Catcher William Contreras was named World Series MVP after hitting .381 across the five-game series.

items.headline: Legendary Actor Sir Patrick Stewart Dies at Age 86
items.summary: Acclaimed British actor Sir Patrick Stewart, celebrated globally for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men franchise, has died at age 86. Tributes from across the world are honoring his decades-long legacy following the announcement of his passing at his Los Angeles home.
